places.place_summary: Cobb Mountain Art & Ecology Project offers wood-fire and soda kiln firings for potters at all experience levels. Wood-firing workshops run six to ten times annually; soda firings are offered periodically. Potters can participate as workshop attendees, join as paying members after attending multiple workshops, or apply for residencies (1-2 months short-term or 10-12 months long-term) with access to a 250 cu. ft. Anagama, 60 cu. ft. Train, and 25 cu. ft. Cross Draft kiln that fires wood, soda, salt, and gas.
